story: In the diverse world of birds, the Brown Fish Owl (Ketupa zeylonensis) stands out. This species, part of the Strigidae family, is a resident of Deciduous; semi-deciduous; and open evergreen woodland near water; ravines; plantations. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Brown Fish Owl is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Brown Fish Owl and its role in the ecosystem.
